body.name: Zero-allowed latent feedback class and law set
body.construction:
Define \(\mathfrak M^{\le}_{\mathcal I}(G)\) to be the set of pairs \((B,(P_{\varepsilon_i})_{i\in V})\) such that \(\operatorname{supp}(B)\subseteq E(G)\), \(\det(Q_{V\setminus S,V\setminus S})\ne0\) for every \(S\in\mathcal I\), the source coordinates are mutually independent, nonconstant, and non-Gaussian real random variables with no location or moment restriction, and interventions are surgical.  Define
\[
 \mathcal P^{\le}_{\mathcal I}(G)
 =\{\mathbf K_{\mathcal I}(B,\varepsilon):(B,(P_{\varepsilon_i})_{i\in V})
 \in\mathfrak M^{\le}_{\mathcal I}(G)\}.
\]
